title: Flu clinic hours extended
body: Walk-in flu vaccination available weekdays 7:00–19:00 at Pavilion B through September 30. Staff may direct eligible patients without a scheduled visit.

title: Parking garage Level 2 closed Saturday
body: Structural maintenance on Garage Level 2 this Saturday 06:00–14:00. Use East Lot shuttle or Garage Levels 3–5. Display notices at Front Desk.

title: New referral form for cardiology
body: Cardiology external referrals now require Form CR-14. Previous CR-11 forms will be returned. Copies are at the Front Desk binder and on the intranet.

title: All-staff briefing: Monday 08:15
body: Brief campus update in Auditorium A. Front-desk coverage rotation is posted on the staffing board. Attendance encouraged for shift leads.

title: Interpreter services: Mandarin coverage
body: On-site Mandarin interpreter available Tue/Thu 09:00–15:00. Outside those hours use LanguageLine. Update visit notes with interpreter ID when used.
